gui.blackbox.handbook.title: Blackbox Handbook
gui.blackbox.handbook.page.0.title: 1. Create a Farm
gui.blackbox.handbook.page.0.body: Place a Dimensional Workbench and insert a Dimension Core. Name the farm and choose a 1x1, 2x2 or 3x3 cell upgrade before the first visit. The core receives a permanent ID and its own isolated cell.
gui.blackbox.handbook.page.1.title: 2. Connect the Farm
gui.blackbox.handbook.page.1.body: The blue Farm Input receives items, fluids and energy from the workbench. Products enter the green Farm Output and travel back automatically. While inside, misplaced items can still be removed manually.
gui.blackbox.handbook.page.2.title: 3. Record Production
gui.blackbox.handbook.page.2.body: Leave through the dimensional bedrock. After internal preparation, the workbench measures inventories, fluid tanks and energy storage for the server-configured duration. Measurements survive restarts. Re-entering cancels and clears the profile for editing.
gui.blackbox.handbook.page.3.title: 4. Simulate the Farm
gui.blackbox.handbook.page.3.body: After measurement, the Dimensional Workbench already runs as a Blackbox. You can also move the programmed core into a separate Blackbox. Both consume measured inputs above and place simulated products below. Hold Shift on the core for per-minute values.
gui.blackbox.handbook.page.4.title: 5. Upgrades
gui.blackbox.handbook.page.4.body: Core upgrades choose cell size, environment and mob spawning before the first visit. The reusable Stability Upgrade belongs to a Blackbox and spaces all outputs evenly; without it, measured item peaks and quiet periods are replayed.
gui.blackbox.handbook.page.5.title: 6. Blueprints
gui.blackbox.handbook.page.5.body: The blue Blueprint paper is reusable and stores no farm itself. Right-click the air to open the library, where you can select a template or name a new one at any time. A normal click on the dimensional floor applies the selection. Shift-click always saves a new template.
gui.blackbox.handbook.page.6.title: 7. Server Rules
gui.blackbox.handbook.page.6.body: Local Blueprints are the default and work across worlds or servers. The library supports selection, revisions, rename, delete, download and operator publishing. The Admin Book manages blocked blocks and can remove registered farm cells.
